title: The Little Bottle
summary: 得到魔法物+为他人所用:主角躲雨进森林老奶奶家,得一只「只能为别人用」的魔法小瓶,次日用它救出掉进洞的小猫。
text: Deep in the green forest, there was a little house. An old woman named Granny Rose lived there. People said that she knew old magic. One afternoon, {{name}} walked into the forest to pick fruit. Suddenly, dark clouds covered the sky. Rain fell like a river, and {{name}} ran to the little house. Granny Rose opened the door with a warm smile. "Come in, child. I have waited for you," she said. "Waited for me? But you have never met me!" said {{name}}. "My owl has told me everything," she laughed. A big old owl sat by the fire. Its eyes were bright like gold. "I have lived here for a hundred years," said Granny Rose. "And I have helped everyone who comes to this forest." She gave {{name}} a cup of hot tea. Then she pointed at a small bottle on the shelf. "If you ever need help, open this bottle," she said. "But you must use it only for someone else." {{name}} thanked her and put the bottle in the bag. When the rain stopped, {{name}} walked home and thought about the strange day. The next morning, {{name}} heard a sad sound near the school. A little cat had fallen into a deep hole. Nobody could reach it, and the cat was crying. Then {{name}} remembered the little bottle. "This is for someone else, just like she said!" {{name}} opened the bottle, and silver light flew out. The light lifted the little cat up into the air. The cat was safe! Everyone asked, "How have you done this?" {{name}} just smiled and looked at the sky. Far away, an old owl was flying over the forest. Some secrets are best when they stay secret.

questions.prompt: Who lived in the little house in the forest?
